fixture.restart_boundary: Original main restarted against the same owned schema; ordinary seed/startup effects are outside individual before/after request comparisons.

gates.phase: after verified S1 prerequisite synchronization, before no-op product implementation
after replacing new navigation call-log assertions with persisted real version owner state; no production code changed

guard_result: Protection/raw IDs/empty updates/API state/permission/authentication retained; disabled ordinary configuration remains configurable; icon-only does not add rebinding checks.

runtime_interruptions.event: unexpected persistent Python kernel state loss
runtime_interruptions.recovery: adopted only PIDs whose command lines match the durable owned runtime directory; reused existing schema/services and public observations
runtime_interruptions.correction: Durable observations establish ten resource-repair calls and first two forbidden-write calls completed despite the tool reporting a first-line NameError. No completed calls replayed; resume from equal-scope forbidden-write case.

forbidden_write_proof.scope: Owned trigger failures prove no corresponding field/relation/version writes; not a generic no-database-work claim.

late_version_failure_positions.injection: owned MySQL BEFORE UPDATE conditional SIGNAL1644 at the second user version write
owned MySQL BEFORE UPDATE conditional SIGNAL1644 at the second user version write
owned MySQL BEFORE UPDATE conditional SIGNAL1644 at the second user version write

verification_fixture_corrections.observed: MySQL3818 rejected CHECK referencing auto-increment user_id
verification_fixture_corrections.correction: Use an owned conditional BEFORE UPDATE trigger with explicit SIGNAL instead; no product code change, no HTTP request had executed in this phase.

retry_proof.injection: Owned conditional SIGNAL1213 on second insert in first attempt; MyISAM fixture counter survives rollback
retry_proof.claim_limit: Exercises actual existing transaction Runner retry, not a physical InnoDB deadlock.

current_fact_race.scope: Owned native SQL winner holds/updates role then commits; actual HTTP waits and compares latest locked row. This is not a second HTTP writer or a CAS claim.

unknown_parent_observation.scope: Observed current root fallback only; this change does not select or close S4 unknown parent_path policy.

operations.description: 未提交的字段保持原值；显式空字符串清空 description，name、code 不得为空。JSON null 沿既有解析表示未提交。完成保护、唯一性及当前事实校验后，合法同值不提升授权版本；真实角色展示或派生配置变化仍原子失效，空更新仍拒绝。
先校验角色保护及全部原始权限ID，再去重比较实际配置；等价集合成功且不重建关联、不提升版本。真实关系变化仍在同一事务处理角色用户版本。
先校验角色保护、模式和全部原始组织ID；模式与适用组织集合相同则成功且不提升版本。非custom残留关联仍须清理并作为真实变化原子失效。
未提交的字段保持原值；显式空字符串可清空 icon、component 及满足既有约束的 path，name 不得为空。JSON null 沿既有解析表示未提交。permission_code 继续独立绑定码契约，不表示解绑。完成现有校验后，字段与适用派生事实均同值才不提升版本；真实展示或联动修复仍原子失效，空更新仍拒绝。
先满足角色保护及全部原始菜单引用前提，再比较实际显式配置；合法等价集合成功且不重建关联、不提升版本，不按运行时可见性裁剪配置。
先校验全部原始API ID、存在、启用和认证前提；目标集合、最终码及既有规则维护的权限和授权事实均无变化才不重建关联、不提升版本。缺失权限或直接码漂移等修复仍原子提交并处理版本。
按既有路径及父级解析规则创建缺失菜单；合法全skip且无派生写入时返回created为0，不提升用户版本。
